title: Wanda A Gabansa Alamomin Mulki Sun Yi Ruku'u
intro: Tafiya mai ban mamaki tana jiran waɗanda suka yi ƙarfin halin warware wannan sirrin. A cikin zurfin shafukan Ru'ya ta Yohanna, akwai wani sarki wanda haɗuwarsa da annabi zai sake fasalin al'umma gaba ɗaya. Wannan mutum ya yi mulki daga kursiyi mai nisa, wanda al'adun da suka gabata suka jagorance shi, har sai wani lokaci na gaskiya ta Allah ya canza mai mulki da mulki har abada. Shin za ku gano asalin wannan rai mai ban mamaki wanda labarinsa ya haɗu da abin mamaki da zurfi?
clues: Na mulki wata ƙasa mai wadata a cikin ruwa mai nisa, wadda aka san ta da lambunanmu da kuma babban fada.
Ikona ya fi komai girma, duk da haka wata babbar masarauta ta zo ta ƙalubalantar wanzuwarmu da asalinmu.
Ƙaramin tsuntsu yana ɗauke da wani saƙo mai ban mamaki, kuma abubuwan al'ajabi da suka biyo baya sun wargaza duk zato na game da iko.
Lokacin da na ga kursiyi ya canza a gaban idanuna, na san babu wani mutum da zai iya samun irin wannan damar.
Na bayyana a fili cewa ina mika wuya ga Ubangijin sammai da ƙasa ɗaya, ina barin duk abin da na taɓa ɗauka da muhimmanci a da.
Mu, a matsayinmu na al'umma, mun juya baya ga bautar rana ta dā muka rungumi gaskiyar da ta canza komai.

arabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
verse: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until it [i.e., the sun] disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]." (38:32)
